name: Measles & vaccine-preventable
value: US, Mexico, Bolivia lost elimination (17 Nov)
summary: PAHO says the US, Mexico and Bolivia lost measles elimination on 17 Nov; US cases top 5,400, England 1,055
state: PAHO announced on 17 Nov that the US, Mexico and Bolivia have lost measles elimination status; the US has more than 5,400 confirmed cases in 2026, double the 2025 total, with 10 measles-associated deaths reported (AP via OPB). England had 1,055 confirmed cases by 9 Nov, while EU/EEA cases have fallen to about 2,000 this year with no deaths reported to September (Euronews, 17 Nov). Loss of elimination meets Watch; no polio or diphtheria resurgence in high-income countries was found as of 27 Nov.
for_you: Unvaccinated children and adults are most at risk. The NHS advises checking that you and your children have had two doses of the MMR vaccine; GPs can provide catch-up doses.
rubric_hit: Watch: loss of elimination status in the US, Mexico and Bolivia (PAHO, 17 Nov)

sources.title: OPB (Associated Press) — Measles is no longer considered eliminated in the US and Mexico

why: Falling vaccination rates are bringing back diseases once eliminated; measles is the canary for the rest.

rubric.alert: Multi-country surge with rising deaths, or polio/diphtheria resurgence in high-income countries.
rubric.watch: Large outbreaks in high-income countries, or loss of elimination status.
rubric.normal: No large outbreaks in high-income countries.
